main.description: A suggested value for one trail detail of a segment (segments/trail-detail-suggestions). Public: stored only in the author's repo, never in a space, and names its author. The AppView accepts it only from an athlete with efforts on the segment on enough distinct dates, while the segment is active and not a lift, when the value is new and the detail is outside its cooldown, and only one open suggestion per athlete per segment and detail. Rewriting an open suggestion with a different value clears its votes; a rewrite of a closed one is ignored.

segment.description: The app.activitytracker.feed.segment the value is for.

value.description: Only the detail's fields: one surface at 100 for surface, widthCm of 100 (singletrack), 200 (doubletrack) or 400 (road width) for width, and openFrom with openUntil, seasons, or seasonal for season.
